orgDesign.companyProfile: Multi-sided Benelux home-improvement marketplace connecting homeowners, specialist businesses, affiliate demand partners, and marketplace operators across advice, lead acquisition, comparison, trust, and commercial workflows.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Stream-aligned teams own participant outcomes end to end; marketplace-control teams own qualification, allocation, trust, and recovery; platform teams provide partner exchange, identity, data, integration, communications, and reliability as reusable services. Human operators remain accountable for sensitive quality and dispute decisions.

groups.name: Homeowner Marketplace
groups.mission: Help homeowners turn uncertain improvement goals into qualified requests and confident specialist choices.

groupDirectHeadcount.description: Product and engineering leadership for homeowner value, research quality, and cross-journey coherence.

teams.name: Homeowner Intent
teams.description: Own advice, guided project scoping, identity, and consent so homeowners can submit clear, contactable, quote-ready requests without losing control of their data.

teamHeadcount.description: Cross-functional product team with content design, journey research, and privacy-aware engineering.

customerDependencies.description: Primary customer for advice and project-intake outcomes.

streamDependencies.description: Owns the start-to-qualified-submission portion of the flow.

brickDependencies.description: Primary ownership of improvement guidance and category discovery.
Primary ownership of request scoping and capture.
Primary ownership of homeowner identity, contact, and consent.

otherTeamDependencies.description: Aligns request quality with downstream matching requirements.
Consumes communication, identity foundation, and reliability services.

teams.name: Homeowner Choice
teams.description: Own comparison, conversation, and reputation experiences that help homeowners evaluate real specialists and make a defensible choice.

teamHeadcount.description: Cross-functional product team with marketplace UX and trust-sensitive experimentation capability.

customerDependencies.description: Primary customer for selection confidence and response outcomes.
Professional participation shapes messaging and reputation quality.

streamDependencies.description: Owns comparison through selection and review closure.

brickDependencies.description: Primary ownership of specialist comparison.
Primary ownership of customer-professional messaging.

otherTeamDependencies.description: Shares trust rules and review-integrity controls.
Consumes communication and identity services.

brickDependencies.description: Primary ownership of matching, ranking, and distribution decisioning.
